title: Batman and the Outsiders #6 DC 1984 Cryonic Man Mike W Barr Jim Aparo
conditionDescription: Bright and clean, light handling wear. Small handwritten "C-558" at the lower left of the front cover. See photos.
descriptionText:
Batman and the Outsiders #6 (January 1984), DC Comics - the coming of the Cryonic Man! Mike W. Barr and Jim Aparo; Aparo cover. 75 cent cover price.

Back cover: Revell Power Lords action figure ad.

Condition: bright and clean with light handling wear. Small handwritten "C-558" at the lower left of the front cover (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
